title: Article 124 — Establishment and constitution of Supreme Court

content.heading: Establishment and constitution of Supreme Court
content.text: There shall be a Supreme Court of India consisting of a Chief Justice of India and, until Parliament by law prescribes a larger number, a fixed number of other Judges. Every Judge of the Supreme Court shall be appointed by the President by warrant under his hand and seal and shall hold office until he attains the age of sixty-five years. A Judge may be removed in the manner provided in this article. Read the official qualifications and removal clauses.
